name: How long does a typical skylight replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical skylight replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard skylight replacements can be completed within one to two days, depending on the skylight's size, type, and the complexity of the existing roof penetration. Factors such as unforeseen structural damage around the opening or extensive flashing repairs can extend the project timeline. Our team in the Alameda and Berkeley areas aims for efficient installation while ensuring proper sealing and structural integrity.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard skylight replacement usually takes one to two days, but complexity can extend the timeline.
